What I'm building toward

I want to help build the future of independent work.

I've helped scale billion-dollar technology businesses, built a successful independent business of my own, and coached others to do the same.

Now I want to help build the technology that makes that possible for millions more people, with more freedom for family and life.

Let's talk ↗LinkedIn ↗

Three things I believe.

The future of work is fluid.

People should be able to move between employment, consulting, and building their own businesses, without starting from scratch each time.

Doing the work is getting easier.

Building the business is still hard. Finding customers and earning sustainable income is where the real opportunity lies.

Success should create freedom.

The best products help people earn well while making more room for family, relationships, and the rest of life.

Why me

I've lived both sides.

I helped scale Pinterest Conversion Ads into a $1B+ business and built marketing teams at AdRoll and Gitcoin.

Through Positive Sum, I earned more than $500K as an independent consultant and spent five years coaching professionals and business owners. I know how rewarding independence can be, and how hard it is to sustain.
